title: Seven Kinds of Land
summary: Corrupted lands, Dreadlands, desert and sea

blocks.text: Hoanna has mountains, valleys and caves too, but its landscape doesn't line up with the Overworld: where one side has a mountain, the other may have sea. From cold to hot you'll find three corrupted lands (Frozen, Magic, Chaos), then the Dreadlands and the Hoanna Desert; damp places occasionally hold a Shadow Corrupted Land, and the large waters are the Hoanna Sea.

rows: Slate-blue grass, leaves and water, specks drifting like fine snow; rain, never snow
Dusky violet grass, leaves and water, faint lilac dust drifting in the air
The same, plus the odd {item:essentialcraft5:magical_fruit_block} on the grass
Brick-red grass and leaves, dark red water, red spores
Charcoal grass, the darkest sky and fog, drifting ash; rare (about 2% of the land)
Dark brown {item:essentialcraft5:dread_dirt} as far as you can see; no rain
Wide water over a gravel floor

blocks.text: Underground it's the same as the Overworld: vanilla ores, all the infused ores and {item:essentialcraft5:mithriline_ore}, in about the same amounts ([[elements/ores]]). Ancient ruins are far more common than in the Overworld, about one every thirty chunks ([[start/mrucu]]).

No animals spawn here, only the usual Overworld monsters and Wind Mages ([[wind_mage/wind_mages]]). Bring your own food, or look for {item:essentialcraft5:magical_fruit} in the Magic Corrupted Land: [[hoanna/flora]].
{item:essentialcraft5:dread_cactus} pricks like a vanilla cactus and also poisons you for 5 seconds. Don't brush past it while crossing the desert.

The original mod called these lands Chaos / Frozen / Magic / Shadow Corrupted Land, Hoanna Dreadlands and Hoanna Desert. Its Dreadlands were set up to grow dead bushes, yet not one ever grew: Dread Dirt didn't count as dirt.
Goal: gather any plant of Hoanna. They only grow there; you won't find them in the Overworld.

items: {item:essentialcraft5:hoanna_tall_grass} covers the grass of all four corrupted lands and takes on the local grass colour. Shears give the grass itself; by hand it has a 1 in 8 chance to drop 1 {item:minecraft:wheat_seeds} (Fortune doesn't help); bone meal turns it into vanilla tall grass.
{item:essentialcraft5:green_flower} grows in the corrupted lands too. Bone meal on the grass blocks there now and then sprouts a new Green Flower.

blocks.text: {item:essentialcraft5:dread_cactus} grows only on the sand of the Hoanna Desert, up to 3 blocks tall, and breaks if a block touches its side, just like a vanilla cactus. Touching it doesn't only prick: it also poisons you for 5 seconds.

{item:essentialcraft5:magical_fruit_block} turns up only on the grass of the Magic Corrupted Land, two or three at a spot; an axe breaks it quickly. It drops 3 to 7 {item:essentialcraft5:magical_fruit}, 0 to 1 more per level of Fortune, at most 9; Silk Touch takes the whole block.

The blocks never grow back, so make the fruit last. No animals spawn in Hoanna; other than this, the only food is mushrooms, apples from the oaks, and crops you grow yourself from the seeds in the tall grass.

blocks.title: Done when
blocks.text: You've had any of Green Flower, Hoanna Tall Grass, Dread Cactus, Magical Fruit Block or Magical Fruit in your inventory.
{item:essentialcraft5:root} grows in the Old Catacombs ([[hoanna/ruins]]). An axe breaks it; it's purely decorative.
